paragraphs.source_en: The construction of the shogun’s residence at Nijō Castle had likewise been a decision Nobunaga reached only after arduous deliberation. After pacifying the Kinai, Nobunaga judged that restoring the authority of the shogunate was the first step toward steadying the people’s hearts. He therefore expanded the old ruins roughly one chō to the northeast and began construction on the twenty-seventh day of the second month of the previous year. After a year of intense construction, the new shogunal residence was finally complete.

paragraphs.source_zh: 二条城的能乐表演定于十四日进行。

paragraphs.source_en: In the new residence, fragrant with fresh timber, the Kanze Tayū and Konparu Tayū took turns dancing.

units.source_en: In the new residence, fragrant with fresh timber, the Kanze Tayū and Konparu Tayū took turns dancing.
units.source_zh: 在木香飘溢的新府，观世太夫和今春太夫轮番起舞。

paragraphs.source_zh: 在木香飘溢的新府，观世太夫和今春太夫轮番起舞。

paragraphs.source_en: “I never dreamed that I would see Noh performed in the capital again.” Some court nobles were so overcome that they wept. Shogun Yoshiaki personally approached Nobunaga with a cup of sake: “They all wish you to assume the office of Samanosuke. Will you accept it this time?”

units.source_en: “I never dreamed that I would see Noh performed in the capital again.”
units.source_zh: “真没想到还能在京城看到能乐表演。”

units.source_en: Some court nobles were so overcome that they wept.
units.source_zh: 有的公卿甚至感极而泣。

units.source_en: Shogun Yoshiaki personally approached Nobunaga with a cup of sake: “They all wish you to assume the office of Samanosuke. Will you accept it this time?”
units.source_zh: 将军义昭特意来到信长面前把盏：“这些人都希望你能任左兵卫督之职，你此次能接受吗？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “真没想到还能在京城看到能乐表演。”有的公卿甚至感极而泣。将军义昭特意来到信长面前把盏：“这些人都希望你能任左兵卫督之职，你此次能接受吗？”

paragraphs.source_en: Nobunaga hastily shook his head and declined: “No, no. Nobunaga has merely done what ought to be done.”

units.source_en: Nobunaga hastily shook his head and declined: “No, no. Nobunaga has merely done what ought to be done.”

ja.t: した。「なりませぬ、なりませぬ。
は、なすべきことをしたにすぎません」

units.source_zh: 信长赶紧摇头辞谢：“不可不可，信长不过做了该做之事。”

paragraphs.source_zh: 信长赶紧摇头辞谢：“不可不可，信长不过做了该做之事。”

paragraphs.source_en: From time to time, Ieyasu glanced at Nobunaga, deliberately refraining from greeting him.

units.source_en: From time to time, Ieyasu glanced at Nobunaga, deliberately refraining from greeting him.
units.source_zh: 家康不时看看信长，故意没有打招呼。

paragraphs.source_zh: 家康不时看看信长，故意没有打招呼。

paragraphs.source_en: The Noh performance at the new residence did much to weaken the influence of rumors circulating among the people that a campaign against the Asakura and others was imminent.

units.source_en: The Noh performance at the new residence did much to weaken the influence of rumors circulating among the people that a campaign against the Asakura and others was imminent.
units.source_zh: 新府举行的能剧表演，在很大程度上减弱了百姓中间流传的征讨朝仓等传言的影响。

paragraphs.source_zh: 新府举行的能剧表演，在很大程度上减弱了百姓中间流传的征讨朝仓等传言的影响。

paragraphs.source_en: On the first day of the fourth month, Niwa Gorōzaemon accompanied Priest Yūkan to Sakai in Senshū, leading several fine horses laden with gold and silver to purchase celebrated utensils. Because the undertaking had been announced in advance, celebrated utensils from every region came pouring in. Among the treasures gathered at this time were Tennōjiya Sōgyū’s Konomizu-e, Yakushiin’s tea utensil Komatsushima, and Aburaya Jōyū’s flower vase Kōjiguchi.

units.source_en: On the first day of the fourth month, Niwa Gorōzaemon accompanied Priest Yūkan to Sakai in Senshū, leading several fine horses laden with gold and silver to purchase celebrated utensils.
units.source_zh: 四月初一，丹羽五郎左卫门陪着友闲法师，牵着几匹满载金银的骏马前往泉州堺市收购名器。

units.source_en: Because the undertaking had been announced in advance, celebrated utensils from every region came pouring in.
units.source_zh: 因为事前已经公布了这次行动，所以不断有各地名器汇聚前来。

units.source_en: Among the treasures gathered at this time were Tennōjiya Sōgyū’s Konomizu-e, Yakushiin’s tea utensil Komatsushima, and Aburaya Jōyū’s flower vase Kōjiguchi.
units.source_zh: 天王寺屋宗及的果子绘、药师院的茶器小松岛和油屋常佑的花筒柑子口等，都是在此时汇聚起来的。

paragraphs.source_zh: 四月初一，丹羽五郎左卫门陪着友闲法师，牵着几匹满载金银的骏马前往泉州堺市收购名器。因为事前已经公布了这次行动，所以不断有各地名器汇聚前来。天王寺屋宗及的果子绘、药师院的茶器小松岛和油屋常佑的花筒柑子口等，都是在此时汇聚起来的。

paragraphs.source_en: Tens of thousands of timbers were transported from Ōsaka to Toba, and from Toba into the imperial palace. The works were overseen by Ōsawa Ōinosuke. Everything was conducted according to ancient custom. The carpenters wore court caps and plain court robes as they ceaselessly traveled between Toba and the palace, their unusual attire drawing the eyes of passersby.

units.source_en: Tens of thousands of timbers were transported from Ōsaka to Toba, and from Toba into the imperial palace.
units.source_zh: 几万根木材从大坂运到鸟羽，又从鸟羽运进皇宫。

units.source_en: The works were overseen by Ōsawa Ōinosuke.
units.source_zh: 监工是大泽大炊介。

units.source_en: Everything was conducted according to ancient custom. The carpenters wore court caps and plain court robes as they ceaselessly traveled between Toba and the palace, their unusual attire drawing the eyes of passersby.
units.source_zh: 一切都依古礼进行，木匠都头戴宫帽，身穿朴素的宫服，不断往来于鸟羽和皇宫之间，奇异的装扮吸引着路人的目光。

paragraphs.source_zh: 几万根木材从大坂运到鸟羽，又从鸟羽运进皇宫。监工是大泽大炊介。一切都依古礼进行，木匠都头戴宫帽，身穿朴素的宫服，不断往来于鸟羽和皇宫之间，奇异的装扮吸引着路人的目光。

paragraphs.source_en: The eighteenth day of the fourth month in the first year of Genki. Ieyasu announced publicly that, having seen the spring sights of the capital to his heart’s content, it was time to return to Hamamatsu.

units.source_en: The eighteenth day of the fourth month in the first year of Genki.
units.source_zh: 元龟元年四月十八。

units.source_en: Ieyasu announced publicly that, having seen the spring sights of the capital to his heart’s content, it was time to return to Hamamatsu.
units.source_zh: 家康对外称，既已遍览京城春色，该回滨松了。

paragraphs.source_zh: 元龟元年四月十八。家康对外称，既已遍览京城春色，该回滨松了。

paragraphs.source_en: In the blink of an eye, the twentieth day of the fourth month arrived.

units.source_en: In the blink of an eye, the twentieth day of the fourth month arrived.
units.source_zh: 转眼到了四月二十。

paragraphs.source_zh: 转眼到了四月二十。

paragraphs.source_en: “Lord Oda Kazusa-no-suke was nowhere to be seen today.”

units.source_en: “Lord Oda Kazusa-no-suke was nowhere to be seen today.”
units.source_zh: “今天没有看到织田上总介。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “今天没有看到织田上总介。”

paragraphs.source_en: “What in the world has happened?”

units.source_en: “What in the world has happened?”
units.source_zh: “究竟发生了什么事？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “究竟发生了什么事？”

paragraphs.source_en: Swift as the wind in battle, overwhelming as a breached dike in attack—the ever-rapid army of Nobunaga had already crossed Mount Wakaba in the blink of an eye.

units.source_en: Swift as the wind in battle, overwhelming as a breached dike in attack—the ever-rapid army of Nobunaga had already crossed Mount Wakaba in the blink of an eye.
units.source_zh: 战如疾风，攻如溃堤——一向神速的信长军队，转眼就迈过了若叶山。

paragraphs.source_zh: 战如疾风，攻如溃堤——一向神速的信长军队，转眼就迈过了若叶山。
